1000.title: THelpViewer
content: [b]THelpViewer context-sensitive help[/b]
Press F1 anywhere to open the topic assigned to the active view.
Links, long topics and fixed-width tables use the same UHF 2.0 data
model as converted DOS HELP files.
│ Key              │ Action                                     │
│ F1               │ Context help                               │
│ F10              │ Activate the menu bar                      │
│ F5               │ Zoom or restore the active window          │
│ F6 / Shift-F6    │ Select next or previous window             │
│ Alt-F3           │ Close the active window                    │
Topics:
[link:topic=1200]HELP files[/link]   [link:topic=1300]Documents[/link]   [link:topic=1400]Search[/link]
[link:topic=1500]Games[/link]        [link:topic=1600]Windows[/link]     [link:topic=2090]Dialogs[/link]
The status line and Help menu invoke this same help file. Each
TVView or managed window supplies a Turbo Vision-style helpCtx.
Use Help > Index to browse the alphabetical topic index.
This intentionally contains enough text to exercise the shared
vertical scrollbar. Future application documentation can be added as
ordinary UHF topics without changing the JavaScript window.
[link:topic=1700]How context help is resolved[/link]

1100.title: System menu
content: The system menu contains utilities, palette editing, Widget Gallery,
System Information, screen savers and theme selection. About is in
the Help menu.
See also: [link:topic=2040]Colors[/link]  [link:topic=2270]System Information[/link]
[link:topic=2050]Widget Gallery[/link]  [link:topic=2130]Screen saver[/link]

1200.title: HELP files
content: Open installs a HELP or Docs file from the generated catalog.
Catalog submenus open a source directly.
Cross-file links retain the real source filename and open the target
when its bundle exists in the catalog.
See also: [link:topic=2010]Open a File[/link]  [link:topic=2070]HELP viewer[/link]

1300.title: Documents
content: Markdown documentation opens in a read-only Editor-style window with
a blue background and yellow base text.
Use Ctrl-F to find text and Ctrl-L to repeat the search.
See also: [link:topic=2030]Find[/link]  [link:topic=2080]Document viewer[/link]

1400.title: Search
content: Find searches the active HELP or Docs window. Find Again repeats the
last query for that window. Search Topics searches the current HELP
bundle index.
See also: [link:topic=2030]Find dialog[/link]

1500.title: Games
content: Games share Turbo Vision dialogs, keyboard focus, inactive-window
pause policies and a shared server ten-entry Hall of Fame.
The [H] title control opens scores. Its brackets use the title color
and H uses the common frame-icon color.

1600.title: Windows
content: Tile, Cascade and Window List arrange managed windows.
F5 zooms, F6 selects the next window and Alt-F3 closes the active
target. Window controls use the shared TVFrame/TVWindow rendering.

1700.title: Context Help
content: The active menu item has first priority, followed by the focused view,
the active managed dialog/window and finally the application context.
The resolved hc... number selects a topic in THELPVIEWER.HLP, stored
as a UHF 2.0 JSON bundle.
[link:topic=1000]Return to Help Contents[/link]

2000.title: About
content: About shows the application version and authors. The version comes
from the running package metadata rather than a hard-coded string.

2010.title: Open a File
content: Choose a HELP or Docs file from the two-column list.
The ▐↓▌ control opens recent files. The History window has its own
close control, and also closes with Escape or a click outside.
Enter opens the selected file. Double-clicking a directory enters it.
See also: [link:topic=2020]Change Directory[/link]  [link:topic=1200]HELP files[/link]

2020.title: Change Directory
content: Select a virtual HELP/DOCS directory. Chdir applies it to Open a File;
Revert restores the initial path. The History control uses the same
TVHistoryWindow implementation as Open a File and Find.

2030.title: Find
content: Enter text to search in the active HELP or Docs window. The arrow
opens previous queries. Find Again repeats the current query.

2040.title: Colors
content: Choose a Group and Item, then edit its DOS foreground/background
attribute. Default restores the selected item. Reset All restores the
complete Turbo Vision palette.

2050.title: Widget Gallery
content: Widget Gallery exercises shared labels, inputs, list viewers, list
boxes, clusters, scrollbars, buttons, static text, terminal, outline
and message-box components.

2060.title: CD/MIDI Player
content: The compact view contains the display and transport controls. More
reveals the track list and external sources inside the resized frame.

2070.title: HELP viewer
content: Links open topics or companion HELP files. Use Back, Index, Contents
and Search from the status line or menus. The viewer renders UHF 2.0
links, styles, fixed-width text and source-defined colors.

2080.title: Document viewer
content: Markdown is displayed through the read-only Editor palette. The lower
left indicator reports RO plus the current line and column.

2090.title: Dialogs
content: Tab and Shift-Tab move focus. Enter activates the default button and
Escape closes the dialog unless its active control reserves Escape.
Common dialogs:
[link:topic=2010]Open a File[/link]       [link:topic=2020]Change Directory[/link]
[link:topic=2030]Find[/link]              [link:topic=2040]Colors[/link]
[link:topic=2050]Widget Gallery[/link]    [link:topic=2060]CD/MIDI Player[/link]

2100.title: Calendar
content: Browse months and years with the arrow controls. Date calculations use
Gregorian leap-year rules.

2110.title: ASCII Table
content: Shows character codes and glyphs using the configured DOS code-page
presentation.

2120.title: Calculator
content: Use number and operation buttons or the keyboard. Escape is reserved
by the calculator and does not close it.

2130.title: Screen saver
content: Choose a mode from the system menu. Input stops the saver and restores
the previously focused control.

2140.title: Puzzle
content: Move a tile next to the blank square with the mouse or arrow keys.
Solve the shuffled 4 x 4 board in as few moves as possible.
The [H] title control opens the Puzzle Hall of Fame.

2150.title: Tetris
content: New starts a game. Left and Right move the piece, Up rotates it and
Down drops it faster. P pauses the timer. Pentix toggles the extended
piece set.
The game pauses whenever its window is inactive.

2160.title: Mines
content: Reveal safe squares and mark suspected mines. A revealed number tells
how many mines touch that square.
The timer pauses whenever the Mines window is inactive.

2170.title: BreakOut
content: Move the paddle, keep the ball in play and clear all bricks.
Keyboard and pointer controls share the same game state.
The animation pauses whenever the window is inactive.

2180.title: Sokoban
content: Push every crate onto a goal. Arrow keys move the player.
Crates can be pushed but cannot be pulled, so plan each move.

2190.title: Lines
content: Select a coloured ball and move it along a free path. Build lines to
score and remove balls before the board fills.

2200.title: Reversi
content: Place a disc that brackets one or more opposing discs. Bracketed discs
change colour. The player with the most discs at the end wins.

2210.title: Ludo
content: Roll the die and choose a legal piece. Move every piece around the
board and into home before the other players.

2220.title: Mastermind
content: Build a colour guess and submit it. Feedback reports colours in the
correct position separately from correct colours in other positions.

2230.title: Snake
content: Use the arrow keys to steer. Eat food to grow without hitting the wall
or your own body. The game pauses while its window is inactive.

2240.title: Tower of Hanoi
content: Move the complete stack to another peg without placing a larger disc
on a smaller one. Use pointer or keyboard controls; the move history
records every completed move.

2250.title: Tron Light Cycles
content: Steer both cycles simultaneously and avoid walls and every light trail.
The timer and movement pause whenever the game window is inactive.

2260.title: Server Statistics
content: A Turbo Vision dialog shows visits, opened content, search/link outcomes,
games, environment and coarse performance intervals. It also shows active
viewing intervals for HELP files, documents, dialogs and games.
Target time pauses while another window or browser tab is active.
SQLite stores aggregate counters only. It does not store IP addresses,
cookies, visitor IDs, search text, exact timings, full referrers, raw user
agents or individual visits.

2270.title: System Information
content: This dialog shows local application, browser, display, locale, storage
and web-capability information. Its Server section reports server
status, application version and HELP/Docs catalog sizes.
Refresh measures the current runtime again. Opening this dialog does
not submit the displayed details to visitor statistics.
